_Provided by the `@abapify/adt-diff` command plugin (included in the `@abapify/adt` bundle; in a regular `adt-cli` install enable it via the `commands` array in `adt.config.ts`)._

# `adt diff`

Compare local abapGit files against SAP remote (any supported object type)

```bash
adt diff [options] [files...]
```

**Arguments**

| Argument     | Description                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              | Default |
| ------------ | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ | ------- |
| `[files...]` | Local .xml files or glob patterns to compare (e.g., zcl_myclass.clas.xml, *.tabl.xml). When omitted, scans the abapGit repo in the current directory. Supported types: CLAS, INTF, DEVC, PROG, FUGR, FUGS, DOMA, DTEL, TABL, TABL/DS, TTYP, BDEF, SRVD, SRVB, DCLS, DDLS, DDLX, MSAG, VIEW, ENQU, SHLP, TRAN, TYPE, XSLT, ENHO, ENHS, DRAS, DRTY, DSFD, DSFI, DTEB, DTDC, DTIX, DTSC, DESD, APLO, BGQC, CDBO, CHKC, CHKO, CHKV, COTA, EVTB, GSMP, NONT, RONT, SAJC, SAJT, SMBC, UIAD, UIPG, UIST, EEEC, SWCR, HTTP, NROB, CHDO, SMTG, SFPF, SCP1, SICF, SRFC, IDOC, IOBJ, ODSO, SHMA, STYL, SUSC, SUCU, SXCI, SMIM, SQSC, SUSO, SUSH, SKTD, FORM, XINX, PARA, PERS, OA2P, SPLO, TOBJ, SPRX, SOTS, IARP, IASP, CHAR, AUTH, AREA, AVAR, JOBD, NSPC, PINF, VCLS, STVI, SOD1, SOD2, SHI3, SHI5, SHI8, SCVI, ACID, AVAS, CMOD, DIAL, ENHC, ENSC, OTGR, SFSW, SSST, SFBF, SFBS, SXSD, UCSA, UDMO, IAXU, IEXT, SAMC, SAPC, DSYS, FTGL, PRAG, CUS0, CUS1, CUS2, DOCV, DOCT, CMPT, AMSD, APIS, WDYA, WEBI, WDCA, WDCC, PDTS, W3HT, W3MI, IATU, IAMU, DRUL, AIFC, AQBG, AQQU, AQSG, ASFC, G4BA, G4BS, IWMO, IWOM, IWPR, IWSG, IWSV, IWVB, SLDD, SOBJ, SPPF, UENO, WAPA, WDYN, ECAT, ECSD, ECSP, ECTC, ECTD, ECVO, FDT0, SFPI, SSFO |         |

**Options**

| Option                  | Description                                                                                                                    | Default |
| ----------------------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ | ------- |
| `--no-color`            | Disable colored output                                                                                                         |         |
| `-c, --context <lines>` | Number of context lines in diff                                                                                                | `3`     |
| `-s, --source`          | Compare ADK source instead of XML (TABL only)                                                                                  |         |
| `-r, --raw`             | Compare ADT-level XML payloads (what GET returns vs what PUT would send)                                                       |         |
| `-p, --package <name>`  | Scan all abapGit files in the current directory (package name is informational)                                                |         |
| `-f, --full`            | Show full unified diffs (default in single-file mode; in package/multi-file mode only summary is shown unless --full is given) |         |

Global options (`--sid`, `--config`, `--verbose`, …) are accepted by every command — see the [command reference index](./index.md#global-options).
